reason: A DSH web GUI plugin that presents DeepSeek balance, spending, token usage, and trends in a configurable draggable floating card, using local logs and optional DeepSeek platform data.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中以可拖动的液态玻璃卡片展示 DeepSeek 余额、消费、Token 用量及趋势数据。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek balance, spending, token usage, and trends in a configurable draggable liquid-glass card within the DSH web interface.

capabilities: Displays DeepSeek API balance and usage data
Aggregates local DSH session logs for spending and token statistics
Connects to DeepSeek balance and platform usage endpoints
Stores API keys and optional platform userToken through DSH credentials
Persists card position and visual settings in browser localStorage
Provides a link to the DeepSeek top-up page
